bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; establishing a facilities grant program for certain cooperative units; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

Cooperative unit facilities grants.

(a) For cooperative unit facilities grants:

$

10,000,000

.....

2027

(b) A cooperative unit under Minnesota Statutes, section 123A.24, subdivision 2, that is organized to provide special education services or career and technical education is eligible to apply for a facilities grant under this subdivision. An eligible applicant may apply to the commissioner in the form and manner determined by the commissioner.

(c) Eligible uses of the grant money awarded include any purpose authorized under Minnesota Statutes, section 126C.10, subdivision 14, clauses (1) to (12).

(d) Each grant award must not exceed $2,000,000.

(e) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to ... percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration.
additions: The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.

(b) A cooperative unit under Minnesota Statutes, section 123A.24, subdivision 2, that is organized to provide special education services or career and technical education is eligible to apply for a facilities grant under this subdivision. An eligible applicant may apply to the commissioner in the form and manner determined by the commissioner.
(c) Eligible uses of the grant money awarded include any purpose authorized under Minnesota Statutes, section 126C.10, subdivision 14, clauses (1) to (12).
(d) Each grant award must not exceed $2,000,000.
(e) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, subdivision 14, up to ... percent of the appropriation is available for grant administration.
